def calculate_densities(self):
        """
        Calculate the density of inter-contig links per base. Strong contigs
        considered to have high level of inter-contig links in the current
        partition.
        """
        # Calculate the density of inter-contig links per base
        self.density = self.links / self.length

        # Calculate the density of inter-contig links per base for strong contigs
        self.density_strong = self.links_strong / self.length

        # Calculate the density of inter-contig links per base for weak contigs
        self.density_weak = self.links_weak / self.length

        # Calculate the density of inter-contig links per base for medium contigs
        self.density_medium = self.links_medium / self.length

        # Calculate the density of inter-contig links per base for short contigs
        self.density_short = self.links_short / self.length

        # Calculate the density of inter-contig links per base for long contigs
        self.density_long = self.links_long / self.length
